summary: Dublin, Ireland, software developer, Python programming, open source software advocate, member of TOG Hackerspace, strong interest in Linux and FLOSS (Free/Libre Open Source Software), frequent traveler within Europe, critical of corporate practices (especially in tech), engaged in discussions about digital rights and privacy, interest in A/B testing and user experience design, advocates for education and technology access in developing countries, has volunteered with Camara charity, critical of DRM and copyright practices, supports free access to information and technology.
